file_name_cues: In situ chromatin interactomics using a chemical bait & trap approach: SILAC datasets

Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment uses a chemical bait (semi-synthetic histone with PTMs and a photo-crosslinker) to capture interactors, followed by streptavidin affinity purification (biotin-IP) and SILAC-based DDA proteomics. While the study investigates hPTMs (methylation, acetylation), the proteomics assay itself is an AP-MS of the interactome, not a global PTM-enrichment (like TiO2 or K-GG) of the total proteome.

organism: The Uniprot human proteome reference database was used (proteome ID UP000005640)
cell_lines: HEK 293T cells were plated in DMEM for SILAC media
scope: A biotin-IP was performed to isolate the modified H3 proteins as well as crosslinked proteins, before on-bead digestion with trypsin, desalting, and LC-MS/MS analysis.
The immunoprecipitation was performed at room temperature for two hours, with end-over-end rotation.
